_comment: NestJS service — Node runtime + decorator metadata (experimentalDecorators, emitDecoratorMetadata) required by @nestjs/* decorators and class-validator. verbatimModuleSyntax is off here, and only here: `nest build` emits CommonJS, and under verbatimModuleSyntax every `import`/`export` in a file TypeScript resolves as CJS is TS1287/TS1295. erasableSyntaxOnly is off for the same reason: constructor parameter properties are how @nestjs/* does dependency injection, and they are not erasable syntax. The rest of base.json still applies.
